bio.text: Lori Garcia Sander, a Republican, represents District 65 (Larimer and Weld counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives; Ballotpedia lists her as Lori Sander.
She has held the seat since January 2025, succeeding Michael Lynch, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.

She was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming, earned an associate degree from Aims Community College in 1994 and a bachelor's degree in 1998 and a graduate degree in 2003 from the University of Northern Colorado.
Her career experience includes working in education administration.
